description.value: City Centre Spirits is a small, locally owned liquor store in Courtenay that has been serving the community since 2003. The shop emphasizes hand-selected quality products over sheer volume, and actively stocks locally produced spirits, wines, and beers from the region. A VIP loyalty program rewards repeat customers with points redeemable for in-store discounts and merchandise.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: bollard (4 spaces) at 49m; rack (4 spaces) at 63m; rack (3 spaces) at 100m. Total: 11 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and clearly describes an active retail liquor store at 315 8th Street, Courtenay, BC, matching the OSM record exactly. Phone '1 250 331 0111' and address are both confirmed on the website. The website content contains no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so all those fields remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible retail liquor store operating since 2003 with a confirmed working website and matching contact details. Useful stop for touring cyclists stocking up on beverages.
